review.body: { let disclosure = & act . authentication_evidence ; let expected = HeaderParts { body : ProposalBody { id : act . id . clone () , body : act . body . clone () , legs : act . legs . clone () , protocol_references : act . protocol_references . clone () , content : header . parts . body . content , dependency : header . parts . body . dependency , } , commitments : act . commitments . clone () . ok_or (EncodingError :: Proposal) ? , actor_signature : disclosure . actor_proposal_signature . as_slice () . try_into () . map_err (| _ | EncodingError :: ActorSignature) ? , content_edition : disclosure . content_edition . clone () , dependency_edition : disclosure . dependency_edition . clone () , } ; compare_header (header , & expected , disclosure) }
review.item_premise: Complete public arguments and results are recorded, including retained bytes. This operation establishes representation or comparison only, never signature validity, secret possession or chain authority.
